descriptionChirho: Qal participle used as a substantive noun denoting a potter or craftsman who shapes clay vessels (Arabic فَخَّار/خَزَّاف, Korean 토기장이/도공, Swahili mfinyanzi).
Qal active sense of physically shaping, forming, or creating something, especially God forming humans, animals, or the earth (Arabic جَبَلَ/صَوَّرَ, Korean 빚다/지으시다, Swahili kuumba/kufanya).
Qal sense of mentally forming or purposing a plan, extending the physical forming metaphor to cognitive planning (Korean 계획하다 'to plan', English 'purposed/devised').
Nifal passive indicating simple passive formation, 'to be formed or fashioned' (Arabic يُصوَّرْ, Korean 지음을 받다, Swahili umbwa).
Pual intensive passive indicating thorough or completed formation, 'to have been fully formed' (Arabic تَشَكَّلَتْ, Korean 지어졌나이다, Swahili zilizopangwa).
Hofal causative passive indicating being caused to be formed or fashioned (Arabic يُصْنَعُ, Korean 만들어진, Swahili inayofanywa).
